disabled_reason: JS-rendered (React + lazy-load). Plain requests returns placeholder HTML. Requires headless browser.
notes: Large marketplace, JS-rendered React/Next.js app with dynamically generated styled-components class names (sc-xxxx hashes) that are NOT stable across deploys - avoid relying on those, use the stable data-cy attributes instead (data-cy="article-grid", data-cy="article-card", data-cy="product-price") plus a[title] for product name and a[href*="/tuote/"] for the link. Products are lazy-loaded via client-side JS (initial HTML shows 'Ladataan tuotetta...' placeholders) - requires a headless browser / JS rendering, plain requests+BS4 will not see products. Confirmed 'Sivu 1/25' text indicator and ?page={page} query param links present in DOM (up to page=25). No explicit in-stock/out-of-stock badge found on listing cards - all 48 sampled items had a working 'Lisää ostoskoriin' buy button, so in_stock could not be reliably detected from the listing page alone (marketplace listings for out-of-stock items are typically just not shown).
